notes: מִקְרֶה is recast verbally three times; rule 46's closing paragraph keeps the supplied 'that which' with the noun's own unit and rule 31 heads each on 'befalleth', the word carrying the noun's lexeme. At s011 the supplied generic 'thing' joins the same unit and does not take the head.

t025/t027 'they ... all' is one discontinuous rendering of the possessive preposition's object כֹּל, with 'have' on the לְ under rule 43; the competing reading marks 'they' added as a supplied subject and is named in the unit note.
s030 אָדָם takes 'man hath', the construct relation recast possessively going to the rectum (rules 19 and 43), which matches the reading taken at ECC.3.9 for the same construction.
s006 is unrepresented because the ASV writes no connective for that waw, running the second phrase straight on; s010's waw takes the 'even' written for it (rule 14).
